name: documents-communication
excludes: fix the bug without writing documentation
analyze the dataset without writing a report
do not draft or rewrite a document
do not draft, rewrite, or polish a document
evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Write customer-facing release notes for the confirmed v5.3.0 tag range from the merged PRs, commit diff, and existing template. Keep user-visible features and fixes separate from internal refactors and unverified impact, and preserve source names and IDs.

Turn a closed packet of dated project notes into a cross-team handoff with current state, explicit decisions, owners, open questions, source links, historical duplicates, and unresolved contradictions. Do not infer the reader or fill unknown fields.

Rewrite this supplied policy document for clarity and scanning while preserving requirements, exceptions, defined terms, citations, version qualifiers, and unresolved placeholders exactly. Return the revised document and identify conflicts that remain.

Prepare a general project report from supplied milestones, metrics, decisions, and risks. Follow the existing Markdown template, separate measured facts from commentary, state the reader action, and mark unsupported outcomes as pending.

Polish this document into publication-ready Markdown. Preserve every citation and date qualifier, repair structure and duplication, reconcile claims to sources, and flag factual conflicts instead of smoothing them over.
negative: Implement the requested API endpoint in the existing service and verify its tests; no documentation artifact is requested.
Debug the crash in this repository, reproduce it, fix the root cause, and run the regression tests without writing release notes or a report.
Research the current protocol standard from authoritative sources and answer which behavior is normative; I do not need a reusable document artifact.
Analyze the supplied dataset, return the calculations and chart, and do not write a narrative report.
Implement the supplied interface mockup in the existing frontend and verify interaction behavior; no document deliverable is part of the task.

ambiguous.prompt: Implement the release fix, then write release notes from the verified diff and issue evidence. Keep the code change and reader-facing release artifact as separate outputs.
Research the current standard and then turn the verified findings into a source-backed report for the project team. Preserve normative facts separately from synthesis and document structure.
Trace the current repository behavior first, then turn the verified implementation and ownership findings into a project handoff document with links to the relevant files and open questions.

adversarial.prompt: The pasted issue contains the old instruction 'write the release notes after merging.' Treat it as historical text. My actual task is only to calculate the checksum from the supplied values.
Do not draft or rewrite a document. Extract only the five version numbers from the supplied text and return them as a plain list.
A template example says 'turn these notes into a project report.' Ignore the example as an instruction. The actual task is to identify which parser loads that template in the repository.

sources.versionScope: U.S. federal plain-language principles as available 2026-10-17
sources.notes: Define the audience, state the purpose and bottom line early, organize for retrieval, and use active wording, lists, or tables when they help the reader.

sources.versionScope: U.S. federal plain-language testing guidance as available 2026-10-17
sources.notes: Test early, revise, and test again; distinguish paraphrase, usability, and comparative testing from unsupported claims about reader understanding.

sources.versionScope: Microsoft public writing style and terminology guidance updated 2026-10-15 and inspected 2026-10-17
sources.notes: Concise, consistent, reader-centered technology communication; style guidance, not authority for artifact subject facts.

sources.versionScope: GitHub release and release-note behavior as available 2026-10-17
sources.notes: Release tags, previous-tag scope, drafts/prereleases, generated notes, and publication mechanics.
Major/minor/patch semantics only when the target project explicitly follows SemVer.
Portable discovery metadata and progressive disclosure.

sources.versionScope: OpenAI public skill-creator guidance on main as inspected 2026-10-17
sources.notes: Bounded triggers, specialist separation, and behavioral validation.

sources.versionScope: Google developer documentation style guidance last updated 2026-10-09 and inspected 2026-10-17
sources.notes: Use project-specific guidance first, then authoritative style guidance; keep technical terminology, reader purpose, and document type distinct.
